desc: Tour operators running guided experiences on the Mornington Peninsula. Editorial assessments of who each operator suits and what they deliver.

titles: Boutique Wine Tour - Mornington Peninsula with Amour of the Grape Tours · Peninsula Insider
desc: Amour of the Grape is an owner-operated boutique wine tour run by Paul and Liz Gough, who live on the Peninsula and lead every departure themselves. The maximum group size of seven keeps each cellar door visit closer to a private tasting than a group tour, and the itinerary is adjusted on the day to match the group's preferences and the season's releases.

titles: Arthurs Seat Eagle Gondola Ride with Arthurs Seat Eagle · Peninsula Insider
desc: The Arthurs Seat Eagle gondola connects its Base Station on Arthurs Seat Road in Dromana to the 305-metre summit of Arthurs Seat in a 15-minute one-way ride, delivering panoramic views over Port Phillip Bay and the Peninsula hinterland along the way. Level boarding accommodates wheelchairs and prams that fit the 80cm cabin doorway; oversized equipment may not fit, and mobility scooters cannot enter the cabins. Return tickets are standard; one-way tickets are available for those who want to walk one leg.

titles: Luxury Peninsula Day - Private Wine and Food Tour with Australian Journeys · Peninsula Insider
desc: Australian Journeys operates exclusively private tours for groups of 2 to 11, with a fleet that scales the vehicle to the group: large SUV, 11-seater mini-bus, 24-seater bus, or private car. The gourmet food and wine focus is the operator's core positioning, with fine dining Peninsula venues forming the centrepiece of each day alongside cellar door visits. Established in 2019, the per-person entry point is one of the more accessible starting points in the premium-private category.
h1: Luxury Peninsula Day - Private Wine and Food Tour

titles: Mornington Peninsula Day Tour with Autopia Tours · Peninsula Insider
desc: Autopia Tours has been running small-group day tours from Melbourne since 1987 and holds one of the largest verified Tripadvisor records in this category: 2,218 reviews at a 4.8 average. The Peninsula wine tour operates daily with multiple CBD pickup points, making it the most operationally reliable entry point for guests booking on shorter notice or staying across different Melbourne hotel precincts.

titles: Bayplay Sea Dragon Snorkel Tour with Bayplay Adventure · Peninsula Insider
desc: Bayplay advertises a guided, approximately two-hour snorkel with weedy sea dragons in Portsea. The operator says guests meet for a briefing and walk to the beach. Portsea Pier is closed to public access during Parks Victoria maintenance, so confirm the current water entry and access arrangements with Bayplay before booking.

titles: Corporate Day Charter - Mornington Peninsula with Great Private Tours · Peninsula Insider
desc: Great Private Tours has been operating luxury Mercedes-Benz Sprinter charters on the Peninsula since 2016, with a confirmed Tripadvisor record of 92 reviews at 5.0 out of 5. The corporate day charter format covers two to three cellar door visits with premium tastings and a fine dining Peninsula lunch across a 9 to 10 hour day. The standard vehicle accommodates 2 to 8 guests; an extended format runs to 4 to 11. The per-person entry point is competitive within the premium-private segment for a full-day private charter.

titles: Mornington Peninsula Wine and Cheese Tour with Local Way Tours · Peninsula Insider
desc: Local Way Tours combines cellar door visits with a structured artisan cheese pairing at a Peninsula producer, making this the most food-focused of the mid-range wine tours from Melbourne. The per-person rate is the lowest verified entry point in the daily-departure small-group category, and the fleet, a Mercedes Sprinter, Renault Master, or Yutong midi coach depending on group size, keeps numbers tight enough to stay social. The Tripadvisor record of 484 reviews at 4.9 out of 5 is the strongest verified rating in this segment.
h1: Mornington Peninsula Wine and Cheese Tour

titles: Private Hens Day - Mornington Peninsula with Melbourne Elite Tours · Peninsula Insider
desc: Melbourne Elite Tours fills a specific gap in the Peninsula hens day market: a fully private luxury Mercedes van for up to seven guests, at a rate that becomes competitive with shared-group options once the per-person arithmetic is applied. The itinerary is built in consultation with the booking party, which means the group moves at its own pace, stops where it wants to stop, and the day reflects the hens party's priorities rather than a fixed circuit. The Tripadvisor record of 23 reviews at a 5.0 average is a small sample, but it is an encouraging early signal.

titles: Private Driver-Guide Wine Day - Mornington Peninsula with Localing Private Tours Melbourne · Peninsula Insider
desc: Localing is a premium-private operator that builds each Peninsula day around the specific group: their wine knowledge level, varietal interests, and preferred pace. The price reflects a private guide day rate rather than a tour fare, and the multilingual capability in English, Spanish, Mandarin, French, German, and Italian is the most practical differentiator in this market. For a couple or small group who want a fully bespoke Peninsula day with a local expert, this is the reference product.
h1: Private Driver-Guide Wine Day - Mornington Peninsula

titles: Moonlit Sanctuary Twilight Tour with Moonlit Sanctuary Wildlife Conservation Park · Peninsula Insider
desc: The Moonlit Sanctuary Twilight Tour is a guided nocturnal walk through the park after dark, timed to coincide with when the resident Australian native animals are most active. The small group is led by a guide who handles and presents animals including eastern quolls, bettongs, brush-tailed phascogales, and little penguins, providing conservation context throughout. Tour sizes are capped at 20 participants to maintain a close, quiet experience.

titles: Moonraker Whale Watching Tour with Moonraker Charters · Peninsula Insider
desc: Moonraker's whale watching tour runs from June through October, when humpback and southern right whales migrate through Port Phillip Heads on their way along the Victorian coastline. The tour operates from Sorrento Pier on a vessel accommodating up to 36 passengers, with all viewing from the deck rather than in the water. Outside the whale season, the same tour departs as a dolphin and bay wildlife cruise.

titles: Hot Springs + Wine Combination Tour with Mornington Peninsula Plunge Wine Tours · Peninsula Insider
desc: Plunge Wine Tours is a private boutique operation run by Arthur O'Bryan, who brings over 25 years of Mornington Peninsula wine industry experience to every departure. The tour combines private cellar door tastings with a session at Peninsula Hot Springs, Fingal, and operates as an exclusive charter: no shared vehicles, no fixed group departure times.

titles: Polperro Dolphin Swim with Polperro Dolphin Swims · Peninsula Insider
desc: Polperro's dolphin swim tour puts participants in the water alongside wild bottlenose dolphins in Port Phillip Bay, departing from Sorrento Pier in groups of up to 12. Encounters are guided by licensed marine naturalists who position swimmers near dolphin pods while the RIB holds station nearby. The tour runs year-round, though summer and autumn offer the warmest water temperatures.

titles: Mornington Peninsula Wine Tour with Rick's Wine Tours · Peninsula Insider
desc: Rick's Wine Tours occupies a specific niche in the Peninsula wine tour market: a fully private, customisable day at a per-person price that undercuts most competitors by 20 to 40 per cent. Every booking is a private charter, the guest selects the wineries, and pickup can be arranged from the Melbourne CBD or directly from the Mornington region.

titles: Searoad Ferries: Sorrento–Queenscliff Bay Crossing with Searoad Ferries · Peninsula Insider
desc: The 40-minute roll-on/roll-off ferry crossing between Sorrento and Queenscliff traverses Port Phillip Bay and connects the Mornington Peninsula to the Bellarine Peninsula. For adults, it is a practical route that bypasses the Melbourne ring-road. For children, it tends to become the most memorable part of the day.

titles: Temptation Sailing Bay Cruise with Temptation Sailing · Peninsula Insider
desc: Temptation Sailing's bay cruise departs Sorrento Pier aboard a classic sailing vessel for a half-day passage across Port Phillip Bay. The pace is deliberately unhurried: sailing is the primary experience, with wildlife encounters a welcome possibility rather than the focus. Dolphin sightings are common but not structured into the itinerary. Groups are capped at 18 to keep the vessel uncrowded.

titles: Coastal + Wine Day Tour with Wine Hop and Coastal Tours · Peninsula Insider
desc: Wine Hop and Coastal Tours holds an Ecotourism Australia certification, which distinguishes it from the broader Peninsula wine tour field. The day combines structured coastal interpretation at Peninsula sites with cellar door tastings and an included lunch, and operates on Fridays only.

titles: Arthurs Seat Eagle · Tour Operator · Peninsula Insider
desc: Arthurs Seat Eagle is a gondola lift connecting its Base Station on Arthurs Seat Road in Dromana to the 305-metre summit of Arthurs Seat, delivering panoramic views over Port Phillip Bay and the Peninsula hinterland in a 15-minute one-way journey. The system reopened in 2016 following a major infrastructure rebuild and offers level boarding for wheelchairs and prams that fit the 80cm cabin doorway. Oversized equipment may not fit, and mobility scooters cannot enter the cabins. The summit has a cafe (Eagles Nest) and access to marked walking tracks.

titles: Amour of the Grape Tours · Tour Operator · Peninsula Insider
desc: Amour of the Grape Tours is a small family-run operation based on the Mornington Peninsula, run by locals Paul and Liz Gough. They offer personalised wine, food, and Peninsula day tours in groups of 2 to 7, with Saturday departures accommodating up to 11. Tours run daily across wine, hot springs, beer, cider, spirits, and regional experiences.

titles: Australian Journeys · Tour Operator · Peninsula Insider
desc: Australian Journeys is a Melbourne-based private tour operator founded in 2019. They run exclusively private wine and food tours to the Mornington Peninsula for groups of 2 to 11, with door-to-door pickup and flexible itineraries. Larger buses up to 24 seats are available for bigger groups.

titles: Autopia Tours · Tour Operator · Peninsula Insider
desc: Autopia Tours is a Melbourne-based ecotourism operator founded in 1987, running small-group day tours from the city. On the Mornington Peninsula, their flagship product is an official hot springs shuttle with skip-the-queue entry to Peninsula Hot Springs, plus scenic stops at Arthurs Seat and the beach boxes.

titles: Great Private Tours · Tour Operator · Peninsula Insider
desc: Great Private Tours is a Melbourne-based luxury private tour operator founded in 2016, running bespoke Mornington Peninsula winery tours in Mercedes-Benz vehicles including the Sprinter. Groups of 2 to 8 on private bookings, or up to 11 on their small-group luxe product, travel over 9 to 10 hours with expert local guides.

titles: Local Way Tours · Tour Operator · Peninsula Insider
desc: Local Way Tours runs premium small-group tours to the Mornington Peninsula from Melbourne, covering wine, hot springs, food, and sightseeing. Their fleet includes a Mercedes Sprinter, Renault Master, and a 27-seat Yutong midi coach, allowing groups from a handful of people up to 15 to travel in modern, comfortable vehicles.

titles: Bayplay Adventure · Tour Operator · Peninsula Insider
desc: Bayplay Adventure runs guided snorkelling and other outdoor experiences from Portsea. Its current Sea Dragon tour page describes a briefing at the operator followed by a walk to the beach. Portsea Pier is closed to public access for maintenance, so confirm the current route and availability with Bayplay.

titles: Localing Private Tours Melbourne · Tour Operator · Peninsula Insider
desc: Localing Private Tours Melbourne runs fully private day tours to the Mornington Peninsula for groups of 1 to 10. Hosts offer flexible itineraries focused on wine, food, wildlife, and coastal experiences, with local knowledge positioned as the key differentiator over standard tour products.

titles: Melbourne Elite Tours · Tour Operator · Peninsula Insider
desc: Melbourne Elite Tours offers personalised private day tours to the Mornington Peninsula for groups of up to 7, travelling in luxury vehicles including a Mercedes van. Their Peninsula itinerary covers wine, hot springs, food, beaches, sightseeing, and national parks over 8 to 9 hours.

titles: Moonlit Sanctuary Wildlife Conservation Park · Tour Operator · Peninsula Insider
desc: Moonlit Sanctuary is a conservation wildlife park at Pearcedale, specialising in threatened Australian native species including eastern quolls, bettongs, brush-tailed phascogales, koalas, and little penguins. The park operates a captive breeding programme for several species listed under the EPBC Act. Its flagship offering is the guided Twilight Tour, a nocturnal walk held after dark when the resident animals are most active and accessible.

titles: Moonraker Charters · Tour Operator · Peninsula Insider
desc: Moonraker Charters operates marine wildlife cruises from Sorrento Pier, with whale watching tours running from June through October targeting humpback and southern right whales migrating through Port Phillip Heads. Year-round dolphin encounter cruises and bay sightseeing charters run alongside the seasonal whale programme. The vessel accommodates up to 36 passengers, making it a larger and more stable platform than smaller RIB-based operators.

titles: Mornington Peninsula Plunge Wine Tours · Tour Operator · Peninsula Insider
desc: Mornington Peninsula Plunge Wine Tours is a boutique private operator founded in 2017 and run by Arthur O'Bryan, who has over 25 years of experience in the wine industry. Tours run daily in a luxury Mercedes-Benz Viano, covering wine, food, sculpture, and coastal sightseeing for private small groups.

titles: Polperro Dolphin Swims · Tour Operator · Peninsula Insider
desc: Polperro Dolphin Swims has run marine wildlife tours from Sorrento Pier for over 20 years, operating small-group in-water dolphin encounters and seal swims in Port Phillip Bay. The operator holds marine mammal interaction licences from DELWP and uses a rigid inflatable boat (RIB) to reach dolphin populations in the Bay. Groups are capped at 12 participants, keeping encounters genuinely intimate.

titles: Rick's Wine Tours · Tour Operator · Peninsula Insider
desc: Rick's Wine Tours is a Mornington Peninsula-focused wine tour operator established in 2019. They run private and customisable tours for groups of 2 to 24, visiting wineries, breweries, and distilleries with flexibility to choose venues and add activities.

titles: Searoad Ferries · Tour Operator · Peninsula Insider
desc: Searoad Ferries operates the only car and passenger ferry service between Sorrento on the Mornington Peninsula and Queenscliff on the Bellarine Peninsula. The 40-minute roll-on/roll-off crossing traverses Port Phillip Bay and has operated continuously since 1981. For most visitors, the crossing is a functional shortcut; for families with children, it tends to become the centrepiece of the day.

titles: Temptation Sailing · Tour Operator · Peninsula Insider
desc: Temptation Sailing operates half-day and full-day bay sails from Sorrento aboard classic sailing vessels, with wildlife-spotting sails, sunset sails, and skippered private charters available across Port Phillip Bay. The pace is slower than RIB-based wildlife tours, the vessel environment quieter, and the emphasis is on the experience of being under sail rather than guaranteed wildlife encounters.
